units.source_text: 栉笥姬又称胧月夜，是右大臣的女儿，弘徽殿女御之六妹。

en.t: Kushige-hime, also known as Oborozukiyo, was the daughter of the Minister of the Right and the sixth younger sister of the Kokiden Consort.

units.source_text: 今上即弘徽殿女御（今为母后）之子，称朱雀帝。

en.t: The reigning emperor was the son of the Kokiden Consort, now the Empress Mother, and was known as Emperor Suzaku.
